none: PAS NLM-C7D384: Roman Coin: Radiate of Gallienus
contea di ritrovamento: North East Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Radiate of Gallienus (253-268), Reece period 13, Milan mint, (cf RIC volume 5 part 1 no. 499). Obverse description: Radiate bust right. Reverse description: Standing female figure left with right arm extended and holding transverse sceptre in left hand, probably Pax (cf Cunetio nos 635-637). Reverse inscription: [PAX AV]G. In exergue: MP. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this…
